<subject>Re: message from NordostNet GmbH</subject>
<body>
will do! All lists are currently under construction. Will you forward your list as well?

I decided to wait until Thanksgiving to give you G's portrait - is that okay with you? I CAN send it sooner if you prefer. Her school pics are in now too.

Sorry I didn't call back last night. We were toy shopping with Hans-Uwe Ditschlerin and then it was time for dinner, etc., etc. and got a call from Mema where she immediately launched into all of her health problems.  Was Günter Zimmer to your liking?
</body>
<quoted>
-----Original Message-----
From: elwira.plath@nordwind-energie.de
Sent: Montag, 10. November 2025 14:02
To: Anke Anders
Subject: message from NordostNet GmbH

NordostNet GmbH is going on a trip to Flensburg right before Christmas and would like to finish shopping, er, making gifts prior to the trip...not to mention NordostNet GmbH has a very busy party schedule once December gets under way... wish lists for you, Gottfried and P-nut would be much appreciated!
</quoted>
